safetyReview.notes: DRAFT household routine template (redesign EXEC-R1), authored 2026-10-23 by Claude (agent). The If/Then wording is the owner-approved example text from EXEC-R1; every source is a page already cited by reviewed or pilot content in this repo for the same hazard. Review tier LIFE_SAFETY: needs the independent safety review at the exact hash before it can be PUBLISHED; the author does not approve it. Only visible under the local preview gate until then. Revised 2026-10-23 for Gate 1 + Gate 2 (REVISION_REQUIRED at sha256:2b247435…): adds the Lock, Cover and Hold On variant (Earthquake Country Alliance), matching the offering scenario's answer and the drill copy. Unconditional by design: the household plan holds no reliable 'uses a wheelchair' fact (support profiles carry only 'cannot use stairs' and a free-text note), so a conditional clause would have to guess; the clause is harmless where no one uses a wheelchair.

content.title: When the ground shakes
content.summary: Keep a short earthquake routine on your household plan: drop, cover and hold on, then who checks on everyone when the shaking stops.

sources.label: Earthquake Country Alliance (Great ShakeOut) — Drop, Cover, and Hold On

routine.title: When the ground shakes
routine.thenTemplate: We drop, cover and hold on where we are; anyone using a wheelchair locks, covers and holds on. When it stops, {who} checks on everyone.
